Managed Backup & Recovery

A managed service that keeps your critical systems and personal data recoverable across every site, with backups monitored every day and restores tested on a regular schedule.

Discuss This Service ↗What’s included ↓
Format
Ongoing managed service
Onboarding
Typically 2–4 weeks
Covers
Servers, virtual machines, databases, file shares, branches, and Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
Support
A named engineer with agreed response times

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for teams
like yours.

  • Medium enterprises whose operations depend on servers, an ERP, or business applications
  • Companies with branches, factories, or warehouses that need consistent protection
  • IT teams that want proven backups without adding headcount

WHAT’S INCLUDED

What the engagement covers

The exact scope is confirmed in writing before work begins, based on your systems, priorities, and existing work.

01

Recovery objectives

For each critical system, agree how much data you can afford to lose and how quickly it must be back.

02

Backup design and deployment

Multiple copies on different storage, at least one offsite in Indonesia and at least one that attackers cannot delete or encrypt, each verified with a first restore.

03

Branch and multi-site coverage

Branch offices, factories, and warehouses backed up to a central location, with an offsite copy kept in Indonesia.

04

Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backup

Mailboxes, shared drives, and sites backed up independently, so deleted or encrypted data can be restored.

05

Daily monitoring

Every backup is checked daily, and failures are investigated and resolved the same working day.

06

Scheduled restore testing

Restores are tested on a regular schedule in an isolated environment, and the results are recorded.

07

Recovery runbooks and incident support

Step-by-step recovery guides for critical systems, and hands-on support when you need to recover.

08

Retention aligned with UU PDP

Backup retention follows your personal data retention rules, so data is not kept longer than it should be.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

Deliverables your
team can use.

  • Backup design and service schedule
  • Restore test records
  • Recovery runbooks for critical systems
  • Monthly backup and recovery report
  • Incident report after any real recovery
01

Recovery you can rely on

Restores are tested on schedule, so recovery is proven before an incident.

02

Protection against ransomware

At least one copy is kept where attackers cannot delete or encrypt it.

03

Evidence for auditors

Monthly reports and restore records show that backups work, not just that they run.

UU PDP

Obligations this
service supports.

How this service helps you meet the requirements of Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

  • Security of personal data, including availability and integrity
  • Breach response and recovery
  • Retention and deletion

HOW IT WORKS

A clear path
from start to finish.

Every stage has a defined objective, named owners, and documented outputs.

  1. 01

    Onboard

    Identify critical systems and sites, agree recovery objectives, and run the first verified backups and restores.

  2. 02

    Operate

    Monitor every backup, resolve failures, and keep protected copies healthy.

  3. 03

    Prove

    Test restores on schedule and report results to management every month.

QUESTIONS

Common questions
about this service.

Something else on your mind? Ask our team ↗

Do we need new hardware or software?

Not necessarily. We start from your existing environment and recommend additions only where they are needed to meet your recovery objectives.

Can you help us recover from ransomware?

Yes. We restore from protected copies into a clean environment, working alongside your breach response procedure so evidence is preserved.

Where is our backup data stored?

In locations agreed with you, including data centres and cloud regions in Indonesia, so your data can stay in the country.
